description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katugampalagama, Ehetuwewa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420660 (24/0695)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) in Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land adjudication, property ownership determinations, and land registration processes, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
